**Coaching note (80 words):**
Your opponent's bishop on f5 pinned the g7 pawn but didn't defend it. When you see a queen sacrifice that exposes the enemy king to a check, calculate whether a follow-up fork wins material. Here Qxg7+ forces Kxg7, then Ne6+ forks the king and undefended queen—a classic royal fork pattern. You regain your queen and win decisive material. Look for sacrifices followed by forcing moves (checks especially) that attack multiple pieces.
